children: According to CNBC, Mexican military forces captured suspected drug lord Fausto Isidro Meza Flores, known as “El Chapo Isidro,” and two other leaders of his trafficking organization on Friday night in Sinaloa. Mexico’s security chief announced the arrests Saturday morning. The operation was conducted by Mexican army and National Guard special forces in coordination with U.S. and Mexican intelligence agencies. Clashes and flaming roadblocks were reported in the state overnight.

title: Mexico Captures 'El Chapo Isidro' in Sinaloa Operation
